name: hud_cmd_dialog_scalar_deleting_destructor
description: HudCmdDialog::ScalarDeletingDestructor runs the command dialog destructor, optionally deletes self when flags bit 0 is set, and returns self.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 profile vc5_o2_ob1_gx_facs produced symbol ?ScalarDeletingDestructor@HudCmdDialog@@QAEPAU1@I@Z with zero unmasked byte mismatches for 0x40a920 after COFF relocation masking (8 relocation bytes, 2 trim nops; BN size 30, VC size 32).
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x40a920 calls HudCmdDialog::Destructor, conditionally calls operator delete when flags bit 0 is set, and returns self.

Native smoke verifies the flags=0 path returns self and clears representative dialog-owned binding vectors through the destructor, then exercises the flags=1 deleting path without reusing the freed object.
